title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1 PORCELAIN, SPLENDOR RESIDENCE
description_en: Splendor Residence is an ambitious project located in the Porcelan area, just a few meters from the main road. The interior space of the residential complex creates micro green spaces, basketball half-courts, children's playgrounds, 2 green flower gardens and recreational spaces around them. Apartment Information: • 3rd Floor • Apartment Area (Gross): 113 m2 • Apartment Area (Net): 92 m2 • 2 Bedrooms • 2 Toilets • Balcony • Regular square footage. • Perfect location.
